question: Should spawned children inherit the parent's concrete final model-visible runtime tool names after all policy and schema filters, as implemented by this PR?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and appears fail-closed, but it defines the permanent authorization contract for delegated agents; model judgment cannot substitute for explicit owner intent on that boundary.

options.title: Approve concrete final-surface inheritance
options.body: Rebase and merge this approach so children inherit only concrete tools that remain visible to the parent after every authorization and compatibility filter.

options.title: Standardize selector preservation instead
options.body: Pause this PR and define a broader deferred-selector inheritance contract across embedded, Gateway, and skill-dispatch spawn paths.

recommendation.title: Approve concrete final-surface inheritance
recommendation.body: Rebase and merge this approach so children inherit only concrete tools that remain visible to the parent after every authorization and compatibility filter.
